response.message:
What you are planning: **TipKit** — a dark-mode Solana tip jar with a welcome flow, MWA wallet connection, SOL tipping through an MWA-backed `sendTransactions` flow, and a mock history tab.

Assumptions: TipKit has one configured recipient, amounts use SOL, presets are 1, 5, and 10 SOL, and the memo reads `TipKit tip`. There is no custom note, fiat conversion, real history synchronization, or private-key handling.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.description: Introduces TipKit and its purpose, then provides a Get started action. Records onboarding completion without introducing account creation or seed-phrase flows.

screens.name: Connect
screens.description: Uses the `useMobileWallet` hook from `@wallet-ui/react-native-kit` to show connection state, start MWA authorization, display the connected wallet identity, and continue to tipping. Seed Vault and the wallet app retain all signing material.

screens.name: Tip
screens.description: Shows the configured jar recipient, three preset SOL amounts, and a custom SOL input. The Tip action validates the amount, builds a transfer plus memo instruction with `@solana/kit`, and sends it through the hook's MWA-backed `sendTransactions` path. Shows pending, success, and failure states inline, including the resulting signature on success.

screens.name: History
screens.description: A bottom-tab list of mock tip records showing amount, relative time, memo, and status. It remains demonstration data and is neither fetched from RPC nor populated from real sends.

features: Force a consistent dark theme across app and Wallet UI kit components.
Connect exclusively through the MWA-backed `useMobileWallet` hook; no browser wallet adapter or private-key flow.
Build Solana transfer and memo instructions with `@solana/kit`, including a fresh blockhash.
Validate custom amounts and surface wallet cancellation, signing failure, and send failure without leaving the Tip screen.
Remember onboarding completion so returning users can enter Tip directly when a wallet is connected.
plan.navigation: The expo-router entry point is Welcome. Get started opens Connect; a connected wallet opens the two-screen bottom-tab navigator containing Tip and History. If onboarding is complete but no wallet is connected on a later launch, return to Connect.
